usage: The word 表姐 (biu2 ze2) refers to an older female cousin on the maternal side.
It is used when talking about relatives who are older than you and are cousins through your mother's family.
You can use 表姐 in conversations to specify family relations clearly and show respect for elder cousins.
表姐 can also be used to distinguish between paternal and maternal cousins, where 表 is used for maternal cousins and 堂 for paternal cousins.
It is common to use 表姐 to address or refer to your older female cousin directly.

examples.sentence: 我嘅表姐返嚟香港探我。
